author: NorthEast News Desk
body: Kearsarge Regional High School graduate Arden Rossi is representing the United States at the 2026 UCI Mountain Bike Marathon World Championships in San Martino di Castrozza, Italy. The Georges Mills rider is taking on an 82-kilometer course against an international field after earning two national silver medals and building her racing program while attending college.

Rossi is a sophomore at Roanoke College, where she studies biotechnology and mathematics. She joined Team KellCat Racing as she moved into higher-level competition and has balanced training with a demanding academic schedule. Her trip to the world championships required fundraising to cover travel and racing expenses that are not fully paid by the national team.

The selection caps a comeback from a concussion sustained in March 2025. Rossi told the Concord Monitor that the injury disrupted her training before she returned to competition and resumed pursuing a place on Team USA. Her appearance in Italy gives the Kearsarge community a direct connection to one of international mountain biking’s premier endurance events and marks another step in the young rider’s progression from New Hampshire trails to the world stage.

headline: Kearsarge alumna Arden Rossi rides for Team USA in Italy
